levels.surface: الحسن بن علي بن محمد بن علي بن موسى بن جعفر بن محمد بن علي بن الحسين بن علي بن أبي طالب

notes: «أبويهما» («their two fathers») is a pronoun for the fathers of the two co-transmitters: a relation link (rule 7)
the Imam named inside the chain after «عن» is a narrator (owner ruling 2); the Prophet who speaks in the saying is the end, not a link
